metadata.source_scope: PT Hutama Karya public recovery update published 31 December 2025
metadata.time_boundary_note: The public page exposes the publication date but not an exact publication time; the snapshot uses an end-of-day WIB knowledge boundary rather than inventing a more precise timestamp.
metadata.claim_boundary: This snapshot establishes that the represented Blangkejeren-Gayo Lues/Aceh Tenggara corridor was functionally passable by this knowledge boundary. It does not claim unrestricted normal operation or permanent safety.

needs.location_ref: Blangkejeren-Batas Gayo Lues/Aceh Tenggara corridor, Aceh, Indonesia
needs.notes: Hutama Karya reported the Batas Aceh Tengah/Gayo Lues-Blangkejeren-Batas Gayo Lues/Aceh Tenggara segment as functional since 20 December 2025. Operation remained temporary/controlled, including alternating traffic at some points and safety closures under heavy rain.
